generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contractor should obey all KW-3 Conditions
Contractor Conditional tenders are not accepted
The cost of the Tender processing fees shall not be refundable
The authority competent to accept the tenders shall have the right of rejecting all or any of tenders without assigning any reasons
All the items in the tender are inclusive of cost and conveyance of all materials, all lead, lift, loading, unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery, curing for concrete works
Acceptence/Cancellation of the tender are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same

As per Karnatka State Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Blore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare Fund

The work should be executed strictly as per the tender specification mentioned. Contractor should arrange for quality check at different stage of work for quality assurance as per direction of Engineer-in-charge during the work in progress and after completion. If any failures found the cost will be recovered from the contractor and will be recommended for black listing immediately
The work should be Inspected by the 3rd party Agency
Any damage during the progress of work, the damage cost shold be beared by the Contractor.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt Orders
Corrigendum will be published in the web site/News Paper for all modifications/corrections if any
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
If the date mention above happen to be general holiday next working day will holds good in lieu of the date mention

The bidder shall quote rates without adding GST for either materials or works contract or service GST payable by the bidder under this works contract will be paid to the contratctor over and above the bidders bid amount. and the increase in the GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the bidder alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority
THE BIDDER BID CAPACITY should be equal to or MORE THAN TENDER VALUE

The materials Quality control certificates from the authorized quality control laboratories to be provided by the contractor before using the materials and Quality control certificate issued from the QC authority must accompanied with bill
THE WORK INDENT NUMBER SHOULD BE MENTIONED IN THE WORKDONE CERTIFICATE UPLOADED. OTHERWISE BID MAY BE REJECTED WITHOUT EVALUATION
Road should be constructed as per the guidelines of Ministry of Road Transport & Highway/ Indian road congress

itemList.description: CC DRAIN AND DECK Earth work   excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings & bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including  setting  out,   shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,  removal of stumps and other deleterious matter,   excavated surface leveled and sides neatly  dressed  disposing  off  the  excavated  stuff  or  sorting  &    stacking  the selected  stuff for reuse in a radius of  50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work.In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 1.5 m .(SR-2023-24, Volume-I, Chapter-01,Page No.05, Item No.1.4.1).

CC DRAIN AND DECK Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete  for  levelling  course  for all  works  in  foundation.  The    granite/trap/basalt    crushed  graded  coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:4:8 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates.(SR-2023-24, Volume-I, Chapter-02,Page No.15, Item No.2.1.2)

CC DRAIN AND DECK Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete   for  all  Sub  structures  of building,  Irrigation  works,  Sub  structure  works  of  bridges,  Drain  works    & other  parallel  works  from  0.50m  to  3.50  m  height.  The  granite/trap/basalt crushed  graded  coarse  aggregates    and  fine  aggregates    as  per  relevant  IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers,   laid in layers, well compacted using needle   vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of   relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications..M20   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates. (SR-2023-24, Volume-I, Chapter-02,Page No.16, Item No.2.4.2) DRAIN SIDE WALL AND DRAFT

CC DRAIN AND DECK Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete   for  all  Sub  structures  of building,  Irrigation  works,  Sub  structure  works  of  bridges,  Drain  works    & other  parallel  works  from  0.50m  to  3.50  m  height.  The  granite/trap/basalt crushed  graded  coarse  aggregates    and  fine  aggregates    as  per  relevant  IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers,   laid in layers, well compacted using needle   vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of   relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications..M20   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates. (SR-2023-24, Volume-I, Chapter-02,Page No.16, Item No.2.4.2) DECK RAFT, WALL AND SLAB

CC DRAIN AND DECK Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification..All other type of structures. (SR-2023-24, Volume-I, Chapter-02,Page No.18, Item No.2.11.h)

CC ROAD Loosening, leveling  and Compacting original ground supporting embankment to facilitate placement of first layer of embankment, scarified to a depth of 150 mm, mixed with water at OMC and then compacted  by  rolling  so  as  to  achieve  minimum  dry  density  as given in Table 300-2 for embankment construction.  (SR-2023-24, Volume III, Chapter-03, Page No.17, Item No. 3.7)

CC ROAD Construction  of  Embankment  by  excavating  the  available  approved  Gravel/ Murrum deposited at a place or borrow pits during or prior excavation with all lifts and lead, transportation to site, spreading, grading to required slope and compacting to meet the requirement complete as per specifications, including cost of labour,rolling,water,all materials,usage& all other appurtenaces required to complete the work. (SR-2023-24, Volume-I, Chapter-01,Page No.07, Item No.1.8).

CC ROAD Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method). (SR-2023-24, Volume III, Chapter-04, Page No.26, Item No. 4.17)

CC ROAD Providing  and  constructing     un-reinforced  plain  cement concrete pavement, thickness as per design, over a prepared sub  base,  with  43  grade  cement  or  any  other  type  as  per Clause  1501.2.2  M20  (Grade),  coarse  and  fine  aggregates conforming    to    IS:383:2016,   maximum    size    of    coarse aggregate not exceeding 25 mm, mixed in a concrete mixer of  not  less  than  0.2  cum  capacity  and  appropriate  weigh batcher using approved mix design,   laid in approved fixed side formwork (steel channel, laying and fixing of 125 micron thick polythene film, wedges, steel plates including levelling the formwork as per drawing), spreading the concrete with shovels, rakes, compacted using needle, screed and plate vibrators  and  finished  in  continuous  operation  including construction  joints,  ,  primer,  sealant  ,  curing  of  concrete slabs for 14-days, and water finishing to lines and grade as per drawing  and technical specification clause 1501 with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete.  as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work. (PWD CSR 2024-25, Sl.No.16.27, Mord Ref :-1501, CHAPTER - 16,)
